verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no Founder Law material on running a company remotely while waiting, on Canadian or other interim options, or on what happens after a denial. RFE/NOID defense is pre-decision case defense, not post-denial fallback coverage. Entrepreneur Parole and the pathway-mapping consultations are primary U.S. routes or general strategy, not honest coverage of fallbacks.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's materials honestly cover the fallbacks — running the company remotely while waiting, Canadian or other interim options, and what happens after a denial
